title: Introduce presubmit lint divider and dependency minimizer
author: Maya Hernandez
ci_status: pass (all checks green after a rerun)
release_notes: Split presubmit lint into delta (fast) and full (nightly) shards; add a lightweight dependency minimizer that prunes devdeps and reduces install time. No runtime behavioral changes.
description:
Context and motivation: Our presubmit latency has regressed ~25% in the last quarter due to monolithic lint/test runners and a growing dev-dependency surface. This causes larger PRs to wait longer and increases CI cost for iterative work. This PR splits the presubmit lint runner into delta-aware fast shards and a smaller full shard for less frequent runs, and introduces a 'dep-minimizer' utility that prunes unused devdeps from language package manifests during CI to reduce install time and cold-cache overhead.

Goals: 1) Cut median presubmit feedback time for small changes by ~40%. 2) Reduce average CI setup time by trimming devdeps in the hot path. 3) Keep default developer experience unchanged for local workflows (no forced removal of declared deps).

What changed (high level):
- Introduce .github/workflows/presubmit-split.yml: declares two lanes: lint-delta (fast, path-aware) and lint-full (conservative, nightly and explicit run).
- Add infra/lint/divider: a small Go binary that maps changed files to lint shards (JS/TS, Go, infra, docs) and emits a compressed shard key used by the workflow matrix.
- Add tools/dep-minimizer: a Python script run in CI that analyzes package.json/go.mod + the changed file list and removes devdeps not touched by the change for the duration of the job (reinstated after CI finishes). This is opt-in per-repo via .depmin-config.toml.
- Update .github/README-presubmit.md with new troubleshooting and opt-in flags.
- Small edits to package.json and go.mod in packages/* to add dep metadata that dep-minimizer uses (devMeta.ignore and devMeta-scopes).

Design notes and trade-offs: The divider uses a conservative mapping to avoid false-negatives: some file paths map to multiple shards (e.g., changes touching infra scripts and JS code). That means occasionally we run more shards than strictly necessary, but the delta lane dramatically reduces worst-case latency for small author-only changes. The dep-minimizer runs inside the ephemeral CI workspace and only mutates the transient environment; it never commits changes to manifests. We intentionally did not change local dev workflows or yarn/npm lockfile generation.

Testing and validation: Unit tests added for divider mapping (infra/lint/divider/*_test.go) and end-to-end smoke on a synthetic repo in tools/dep-minimizer/testdata. Staging presubmit was exercised on the redwood monorepo for a week via a canary tag; median presubmit latency dropped 36% for PRs touching a single package. We measured CI bootstrap time reduction of ~18% on average for jobs that used minimizer.

CI: Initial run failed due to a flaky network fetch in tools/dep-minimizer integration test; reran the failing job and all checks passed. CI summary: lint-delta smoke (pass), lint-full (skipped for this branch except on nightly), unit tests (pass), go vet/staticcheck (pass), e2e-minimizer (pass after rerun).

Review conversation (highlights):
- Samir Gupta (2026-02-16): "Nice separation — can we ensure the divider respects repo-level overrides?"
  - Maya: "Added .depmin-config.toml and divider now consults .lint-shard-override if present; updated README with examples."
- Lina Chen (2026-02-17): "Dep-minimizer looks useful but I'm wary about edgecases with postinstall scripts. Please add a safety mode that skips minimization when postinstall is defined."
  - Maya: "Added skip for package.json with postinstall and an opt-in flag to force-run (intended for infra repos). Tests updated."
- Tomás Rivera (2026-02-19): "Can we emit telemetry so SRE can alert if minimizer changes CI success rates?"
  - Maya: "Added presubmit_metric.presubmit_minimizer_skipped/ran and posted dashboard update; SRE tagged in the PR."
- Samir (2026-02-20): "Approve after small nits on README."

Follow-ups captured as Linear tasks: ENG-4521 (tune divider mappings per-team), ENG-4680 (expand minimizer heuristics to Python/Poetry), SUP-2045 (support request: opt-out guidance for internal integrations).

Security and compliance: The minimizer runs only in CI ephemeral runners with no persisted secrets. It does not contact external servers except for standard package registries during install. We added a CI hook to abort minimizer if GITHUB_WORKFLOW is not present to avoid accidental local runs.

Rollout and operational notes: Feature is behind a repo-level opt-in flag .depmin-config.toml — initial rollout applied to packages/* and mainstream infra repos. The presubmit-split workflow runs lint-delta by default on PR open/update; lint-full is scheduled nightly and can be triggered manually. Metrics are wired to the presubmit latency dashboard; set an alert if median delta lane latency goes above 60s.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged on 2026-02-22 after approvals and green CI. Changelog entry prepared.

If anything regresses: revert is trivial (single squash commit) or disable minimizer by removing the config file.
